utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll keep it short and practical. What’s the repair drive issue?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s just been hard to keep up with, honestly. I can point you to the main problem if you want.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, please point me to the main problem, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a bit worried about the logistics—when and where should I drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’re okay bringing them by Saturday afternoon at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday afternoon at the community center works for me—I can bring them by then.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you remind me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah — I’m a bit scattered too. I think it was the porch light and that loose step, but let me double-check.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds right — porch light and the loose step. Just point me at what to do first, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to pitch in. If you want, I can also check who’s already signed up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Vik—thanks. I’m headed out to run a few errands, so any updates you hear would really help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep an eye out and let you know what I hear. Have a good run of errands!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — what kind of repairs still need doing on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — we still need to patch a few cracks and tighten up the loose edge by the curb. I’ve got some tools if you want to knock it out together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in — I can start on the cracks while you handle the curb edge. Show me where you want me to begin.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Quinn—let’s keep it simple and follow a clear plan. Tell me what time the repair drive starts and what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thank you! It starts at 10 AM, and if you can bring work gloves and a screwdriver, that would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—I’ll bring the gloves and screwdriver and be there at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — are you bringing the tools for the repair drive, or should I grab anything else?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got the main tools covered, Mina—if you could bring a flashlight and some extra gloves, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring the flashlight and extra gloves.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help bring folks together for the repair drive—who should I check in with first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Start with Mara at the corner house and Ben over on Maple—they’ve both got a few things needing repair.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll check in with Mara at the corner house and Ben on Maple first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Mara — could you help by making a quick list of neighbors who need repairs and any supplies we still need? I’ll organize the rest from there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll put together a quick list of neighbors needing repairs and note any supplies we’re short on. I’ll bring it to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a quick list going—just tell me what supplies the repair drive still needs, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—send me the list, and I’ll tell you what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—what’s still needed, and I’ll add it to my list?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely—people are dropping off tools and supplies already.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’s good to hear. I can stop by and see if they need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You should! They’ll probably appreciate another pair of hands, and I bet they could use someone organized.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me a bit more about the repair drive—what needs fixing and when it’s happening?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — it’s for a few broken things around the school, like shelves, chairs, and a leaky faucet, and we’re aiming to do it this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — I’ll note shelves, chairs, and the faucet for this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just point me to where to drop it off, and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Bo — just bring it by the community center on Maple after 5, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’ll swing by the community center on Maple after 5.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can mention the repair drive to the others and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik—that’d be a big help. I’ll keep everyone posted and make sure the plan stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing—I’ll mention the repair drive to the others and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit out of the loop, but I can help if you point me to what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I can use help sorting the donations and loading the boxes when you have a moment.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can do that—just give me a quick rundown and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey—could you bring your drill and maybe a few extra screws? I’ll sort the rest at the garage.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can bring my drill and some extra screws. I’ll stop by the garage when I’m ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely—I'm keeping a neat list and can coordinate the repair drive details with you. What do you need me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you note the addresses that need pickup first, and I’ll map out the best route?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ll start a pickup list and note each address as it comes in. Send them my way, and I’ll keep it organized for your route plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’ll need the exact time and where we’re dropping things off so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday at 10 AM, and we’re dropping everything off at the community center on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — I can make that work. I’ll be there at 10 and head to the community center on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, just to confirm—this repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still happening today — I’m just checking the final details now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming — same place and time as planned?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple: tell me the time, the place, and what I should bring. Then I can fit it into my routine.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late to the details, but I can check the time and place and let you know what they need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Dane—just send me the time, place, and anything I should bring when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces second-hand—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s coming along nicely—folks have been dropping off tools, screws, and a few spare parts already. I’m still making a list so we know what we’ve got and what we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear—sounds like it’s off to a solid start. If you want, I can keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m happy to help however I can. Just point me to where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s kind of you, Oren — could you help sort the donated tools when you get here?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, I can do that. Just show me where the tools are when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and do you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — it starts at 10am by the school lot. If you could bring a few gloves and maybe a box of trash bags, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll bring gloves and trash bags and be there at 10.
